oci_mitre_attack_026.display_name: OCI-MITRE-ATTACK-026: MITRE T1047: Windows Management Instrumentation
oci_mitre_attack_026.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1047 (Windows Management Instrumentation). Adversaries may abuse Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) to execute malicious commands and payloads. WMI is designed for programmers and is the infrastructure for management data and operations
